remarks: Located at 796 Mattson Drive SW, this 1,461 sq ft Owen model by San Rufo Homes offers a smart and efficient layout in the Mattson community of southeast Edmonton. Featuring 3 bedrooms and 2.5 bathrooms, this detached garage home is designed for comfortable everyday living. The main floor includes a cozy fireplace that anchors the living space, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. A side entrance adds flexibility and future development potential. Upstairs, the primary bedroom and additional bedrooms are well proportioned, offering privacy and functionality for families, first-time buyers, or downsizers. Thoughtfully designed and located close to parks, pathways, and local amenities, this home delivers excellent value in a growing community. Photos representative. (id:67522)
